testnet: persistent public testnet profile (real low-difficulty PoW, minted genesis)
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/42

Today's `testnet` feature is a throwaway harness: trivial all-`0xFF` difficulty (nonce=0 always passes), no dedicated genesis, mainnet seeds, and the mainnet assume-valid anchor — so it can't back a persistent public network. This adds a real `testnet-1` profile so a modest box or an agent can actually mine it. It's the bridge from the devnet loop demo to a real network.

Every change is `cfg!(feature="testnet")`-gated or a runtime branch; **mainnet compiled output is byte-for-byte unchanged**, locked by a test (`mainnet_genesis_unchanged_no_mainnet_change_invariant`: mainnet genesis id `d7b6805c…`, `ASSUME_VALID_HEIGHT=500000`, nonce/timestamp all asserted unchanged).

## What's in the profile

- **Difficulty** — real target `2^252`, ~16 Argon2id hashes/block, 16× easier than mainnet (`2^248`, 256 hashes/block) so modest hardware can mine, with a testnet-only **min-difficulty floor** so it can't ratchet back toward triviality. The DAA tightens toward the 10s target after the first retarget.
- **Genesis** — minted `testnet-1` genesis (own timestamp 2026-06-13, own witness string, genuinely mined nonce) so the id isn't trivially re-mineable. Cross-mainnet replay is already prevented by the per-genesis signature domain from #32/#33 (confirmed, not rebuilt).
- **Assume-valid** — testnet boots assume-valid-off / full-verify from genesis. Two sites needed gating: the startup flag, and the sync-manager cold-bootstrap branch which checked `our_tip_height <= ASSUME_VALID_HEIGHT` unconditionally and wedged every testnet node forever ("no peer at or past ASSUME_VALID_HEIGHT"). Now `node.assume_valid && our_tip_height <= ASSUME_VALID_HEIGHT` — **inert for a default mainnet node** (`assume_valid == true`, so mainnet IBD is unchanged); `--verify-all` / `--no-assume-valid` now full-verify from genesis, which is what those flags already mean. This is the one mainnet-reachable line in the diff; it is a no-op for default mainnet.
- **Coinbase maturity** — testnet 10 (fast faucet/agent iteration) vs mainnet 360 (unchanged); devnet still 1.
- **Seeds** — `testnet-seed.exfer.org` + a clearly-marked placeholder fallback (real seed IPs are filled in when hosts are provisioned); mainnet seed resolution byte-identical.
- **Release build** — via the existing escape hatch only (`EXFER_TESTNET_OVERRIDE=1 cargo build --release --features "testnet,allow-testnet-release"`); the plain `--features testnet` release `compile_error!` guard stays intact, no new always-on feature.

## Verification

- Live local multi-node testnet: node1 boots to the testnet genesis, mines **real (non-instant) PoW** and advances continuously; second and third nodes peer and sync the chain; a `wallet send --expect-genesis <testnet id>` confirmed in a block and credited the recipient 5 EXFER; coinbase matured at 10.
- Mainnet binary builds unchanged with its own genesis id (`d7b6805c…`) alongside the testnet binary.
